messages:
payments-bot: :warning: Card charge failed for INV-2026-0771 — decline code CC_417. Customer: Aster Labs. Amount: $9,120.
lina-ops: Uh—417 is 'processing restricted'. Could be bank block or enhanced card controls. Do we have backup ACH?
anika-cs: Reached out to their AP. They said treasury has a new policy after the acquisition: all payments require a vendor W-9 + vendor registration before cards are allowed. They can process a wire today if we provide W-9 and wire template.
owen-sales: AP contact is marie.chen@asterlabs.com, phone (650) 555-1299. They're asking for our W-9 and to confirm tax residency (US). Also they want to know if we accept split payment (50% today).
tasha-finance: We can provide W-9 and accept split. Quick check: do we require signed SOW or PO to accept partial? Invoice already has PO 112233.
lina-ops: PO is on invoice. If they provide remittance and attach proof, we can mark partial.
anika-cs: Customer: "We will send 50% via wire today once we have W-9 + bank details. Remaining 50% next week. Can you also confirm beneficiary name and EIN?"
tasha-finance: Sending W-9 and wire block now. EIN: 27-3845592. Beneficiary name exactly: Redwood Inference, Inc. Billing address on file: 500 Redwood Way, Palo Alto, CA 94301.
tasha-finance: W-9 (attach): Redwood Inference, Inc. EIN: 27-3845592. (we will attach to external email).
tasha-finance: Wire details to paste:
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: First Republic Bank
Address: 1 Financial Plaza, San Francisco, CA 94104
ABA (domestic): 123456789
SWIFT: FRBCUS6LXXX
Account: 000123456789
Reference: INV-2026-0771 | PO 112233 | Aster Labs
Please email remittance to payments@redwoodinference.com and attach wire confirmation PDF. Intermediary fees to be covered by sender.
```
owen-sales: I'll relay both docs. Marie asked if beneficiary bank might deduct fees — can we absorb a small fee (<$20) to avoid reconciliation friction?
tasha-finance: We won't absorb beneficiary fees for corporate wires — ask them to cover. If they insist, we can make exception for <$10 but prefer not to.
anika-cs: Sending to customer now with attachments and note about partial payment.
lina-ops: Also flagging: log a manual hold in billing system for the remaining $4,560 until 2026-04-07 then attempt automated capture if they authorized.
tasha-finance: Done. I'll create a memo and schedule follow-up reminder for 2026-04-07.
owen-sales: Marie replied: "Wire will be sent this afternoon. We'll attach PO and include INV in the reference. W-9 received. Thanks." :white_check_mark:
anika-cs: Great. Once we receive confirmation, finance to mark partial payment.
lina-ops: If we still see a charge attempt on the card later, payments-bot will post failure; don't double-charge.
payments-bot: Note: scheduled retry attempt for card will be cancelled for this invoice as per manual override by lina-ops.
tasha-finance: Closing loop: partial wire accepted, W-9 provided, pending confirmation. I'll update the invoice status after remittance arrives.
anika-cs: Thanks everyone.
